subject: VentureMed IAM: preflight and evidence roadmap
messages:
From: security@venturemed.com (Markus Hsu)
To: jonas_weber@redwoody.com
Cc: compliance@venturemed.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC2/SIG intake

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and need a compact bundle of IAM artifacts from Redwood to feed into our intake. Specifically we need:

- Example SAML assertion samples (NameID, attributes used for roles, audience/issuer)
- SCIM delta export or a small delta sample showing provisioning events (create/update/delete)
- Role mapping or RBAC matrix for tenant-scoped roles (owner/editor/viewer)
- Short description of how least-privilege is enforced (service accounts, delegated admins, role owners)

Can you confirm:
1) whether you can provide sanitized samples for the items above,
2) an estimate for delivery (we're hoping for a short window: ~5 business days), and
3) whether a confidentiality addendum is required before we accept downloadable artifacts?

We've copied our compliance lead Alyssa Reed. If easier, happy to do a 30-minute preflight call to walk through the bundle.

Thanks,
Markus Hsu
Security Operations, VentureMed
attachments: none (requested)
From: jonas_weber@redwoody.com
To: security@venturemed.com (Markus Hsu)
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoody.com, priyom_das@redwoody.com
Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC2/SIG intake

Markus — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to coordinate. High-level plan below and proposed owners:

Plan & owners:
- SAML assertion samples (sanitized): Laura Bennett (Irene/LAURA) will curate examples and scrub PII. Expect 2 variants: user login and service-account assertion.
- SCIM delta sample: Priyom Das will pull a delta snapshot (CSV) with 100 rows that demonstrates create/update/deactivate events.
- RBAC matrix: I will attach our tenant-role mapping and include notes on default permissions and delegation policies.
- Least-privilege note: short narrative + pointers to the runbook.

Timeline: initial bundle ready by EOD Friday 2026-06-12 (48 hours) — if that works for you. If you prefer us to hold artifacts behind an NDA/DocuSign, we can do that first; otherwise we can provide redacted files via a secure Drive link.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether VentureMed requires an NDA before we upload artifacts.
2) If yes, send the NDA link or indicate route (DocuSign). If no, we'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link below and share credentials.
3) Optional preflight call — we can do 30 minutes tomorrow (Jun 11) at 10am PT.

Drive placeholder (will populate): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-venturemed-proofset

I'll loop Sean for any pricing/contract implications if you need an extended retention or a custom evidence package.

— Jonas Weber
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
attachments: redwood-iam-runbook.pdf (stub)

To: security@venturemed.com (Markus Hsu)

Date: 2026-06-11T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC2/SIG intake

+1 to Jonas. Quick technical notes and what I'll deliver: 

Quoted text:
> From: jonas_weber@redwoody.com
> Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00-07:00
> Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC2/SIG intake
>
> Plan & owners: (see above)

Deliverables I'll attach to the Drive bundle by EOD 6/12:
- saml-assertion-sample.txt — two sanitized assertions (user, svc-account) with inline comments on the attribute mappings we use (email, groups, role_id).
- scim_delta_sample.csv — small delta (create/update/deactivate) with timestamp columns and actor id (redacted).
- brief-readme.md — explains column mappings and what to look for in audit.

Notes on redaction: PII and tenant IDs will be replaced with pseudonyms. We will keep the original logs internally for 30 days in case you require deeper slices.

Question: for the RBAC matrix, do you want a single tenant-scope export or an example across two tenants (prod + sandbox)? If you are submitting to auditors, single-tenant with explicit role owners is usually cleaner.

— Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: saml-assertion-sample.txt, scim_delta_sample.csv
From: compliance@venturemed.com (Alyssa Reed)
To: laura_bennett@redwoody.com, jonas_weber@redwoody.com, priyom_das@redwoody.com
Date: 2026-06-12T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC2/SIG intake

Thanks — this plan sounds good. A few quick items from our side: 

- We do require a simple confidentiality addendum before sharing artifacts with our audit vendor. I'll route a DocuSign link by EOD today.
- For the RBAC matrix, please provide the single-tenant export (prod) with role owner email and the timestamp of last change. That will match our intake checklist.
- Can you also include a short statement describing how Redwood handles SCIM delta conflict resolution (e.g., authoritative source, reconciliation cadence)? Even a paragraph is helpful.

If you can deliver the bundle after the NDA is signed, we'll ingest into our tracker (HS-34567) and loop the audit vendor. If possible, mark the Drive folder with read-only access for auditors only.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alyssa Reed
Senior Manager, Compliance, VentureMed
attachments: NDA-DocuSign-link (to follow)
